Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1134488. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by doc chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno and require canonical SMILES to be present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
